title: My Busy Week
text:
My week is busy. On Monday I go to school. I have English class on Monday. On Tuesday I play football with my friends. On Friday I visit my grandma.

On Saturday I stay at home. I clean my room and I read a book. On Sunday I go to the park with my family. Sunday is my favorite day.

questions.text: What does the writer do on Tuesday?
Where does the writer go on Sunday?
How does the writer probably feel on Saturday?
Why is the writer's week described as busy?
options: They have activities on many different days
They have no free time at all

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
the people you are related to, such as parents and children
the one you like more than all the others
a public place with grass and trees where people walk and play

paragraph_translations: Mi semana es ocupada. El lunes voy a la escuela. Tengo clase de inglés el lunes. El martes juego al fútbol con mis amigos. El viernes visito a mi abuela.
El sábado me quedo en casa. Limpio mi cuarto y leo un libro. El domingo voy al parque con mi familia. El domingo es mi día favorito.
